projects.title: Univest — Trading & Investment Platform
points: Architected brokerage order placement & order management — hardened for security, scale, and low latency.
Binary-encrypted WebSocket market-data streaming with auto-reconnect across app-state transitions.
Raised crash-free users 70% → 95% through crash triage and instant hotfix rollouts.
End-to-end mutual funds: custom BSE headless flow (UPI Intent, UPI Collect, net banking, cards), redemption, SIPs, portfolio — 3K+ orders, Rs. 1.06Cr+ processed.
Unified Juspay headless checkout reused across 4 product flows (Pro, Basket, Commodity, MF).
Cold start 5.5s → 2.0s (64% faster) · API calls −50% · app size −10%.
CMS-driven dynamic UI + runtime page builder — homepage & campaign launches with zero app releases.
Custom deep-link system + AppsFlyer OneLink attribution · CleverTap engagement.

projects.title: Scalper — In-House Charting & Trading Terminal
projects.role: Univest · Built from scratch in under a month
projects.metrics: +12% derivative trade share · +8% more with Scalper 2.0 (~20% combined)
points: TradingView-style chart engine built from scratch — custom indicators, drawing tools, pattern recognition, real-time rendering.
Scalper 2.0 trade-from-chart: average position, stop-loss/target, live order & position lines with full order CRUD.
OI Visualizer: analyzes Open Interest across strike prices to surface market sentiment, support/resistance, and trend reversals for options traders.
Rendering pipeline optimized for lag-free performance under continuous live tick streams.

projects.title: Self-Hosted Code Push — Shorebird, Reverse-Engineered
projects.metrics: Hotfixes: days → minutes · Rs. 14L+ saved per year
points: Studied Shorebird's OTA update internals — bidiff patching, zstd compression, updater.rs — and built a self-hosted code-push platform for Android & iOS.
Hotfix delivery went from days of store review to minutes, eliminating the commercial licensing cost entirely.

projects.title: FinSight AI — Native Android & iOS
points: AI-driven finance companion built natively on both platforms: stock fundamental/technical insights, an options strategy builder, and one-click trading.
Installed-broker detection personalizes user journeys and onboarding.

projects.title: Libgen — Book Search & Reading Platform
points: Entire app built in Flutter with multi-source scraping and aggregation pipelines written in Dart.
Smooth, user-friendly experience to browse and search through any book.
Monetized via LevelPlay ad bidding and RevenueCat in-app purchases.

projects.title: Remote Jobs
points: Helps people find remote jobs across the globe.
Automated pipeline retrieves remote-job posts from X (Twitter) and publishes them to in-app feeds, keeping users linked to fresh opportunities.

projects.title: MBM E-Learning
points: Gives MBM University students semester- and branch-personalized access to comprehensive study materials.

projects.title: Raksha — Emergency SOS Band
projects.metrics: 🏆 Winner — Incubation & Funding Round (SSIP), IIIT Surat
points: ESP32-based women's safety band paired with a Flutter app: a double-press gesture triggers SOS alerts with live location sent to assigned contacts.
Selected for the Student Startup & Innovation Policy (SSIP) at IIIT Surat and secured funding for prototype development.

projects.title: Buckrate — AI Livestock Weight Estimation
points: Computer-vision weight estimator built on image segmentation with custom-trained models.
Cost-effective livestock weight estimation for a Flutter Web livestock marketplace — no traditional weighing scales needed.

projects.title: Weblm — Website AI Chatbot
points: AI chatbot that interacts with and extracts information from any given website, making web-based data conversational and accessible.

projects.title: Greenhouse Monitoring & Control — IoT
points: IoT system monitoring real-time water content, humidity, temperature, and light availability.
Mobile app displays live readings and enables both manual and automatic control of all connected devices.
